```{r }
# Lee datos (o usa tu objeto existente)
df <- read.csv("obesity_clean.csv", check.names = FALSE)
df_obesidad <- read.csv("obesity_clean.csv", check.names = FALSE)
# Guarda etiqueta para evaluación externa (no entra al clustering)
obesity_labels <- df$NObeyesdad

# --- 1) Normaliza texto a minúsculas y recorta espacios ---
norm_chr <- function(x) str_squish(str_to_lower(as.character(x)))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Gender  = norm_chr(Gender),
    CALC    = norm_chr(CALC),
    FAVC    = norm_chr(FAVC),
    SCC     = norm_chr(SCC),
    SMOKE   = norm_chr(SMOKE),
    family_history_with_overweight = norm_chr(family_history_with_overweight),
    CAEC    = norm_chr(CAEC),
    MTRANS  = norm_chr(MTRANS)
  )

# --- 2) Declara factores según tus dominios reales ---
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Binarias / nominales
    Gender  = factor(Gender, levels = c("female","male")),
    family_history_with_overweight = factor(family_history_with_overweight, levels = c("no","yes")),
    FAVC    = factor(FAVC,  levels = c("no","yes")),
    SMOKE   = factor(SMOKE, levels = c("no","yes")),
    SCC     = factor(SCC,   levels = c("no","yes")),
    MTRANS  = factor(MTRANS, levels = c("public_transportation","automobile","walking","motorbike","bike")),
    # Ordinales
    CAEC    = factor(CAEC, levels = c("no","sometimes","frequently","always"), ordered = TRUE),
    CALC    = factor(CALC, levels = c("no","sometimes","frequently","always"), ordered = TRUE),
    # Etiqueta (por si luego comparas): ordinal
    NObeyesdad = factor(NObeyesdad, ordered = TRUE,
      levels = c("insufficient_weight","normal_weight",
                 "overweight_level_i","overweight_level_ii",
                 "obesity_type_i","obesity_type_ii","obesity_type_iii"))
  )

# Si FCVC, NCP, CH2O, FAF, TUE vinieran como texto, asegúralas a num:
df <- df %>% mutate(across(intersect(c("FCVC","NCP","CH2O","FAF","TUE"), names(.)),
                           ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))))

# --- 3) Recipe: ordinalscore + dummies k−1 + escalar ---
rec <- recipe(~ ., data = df) %>%
  update_role(NObeyesdad, new_role = "id") %>%            # excluye etiqueta del procesamiento
  step_ordinalscore(all_ordered_predictors()) %>%         # CAEC, CALC -> 1..4
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = FALSE) %>% # k−1 dummies (evita colinealidad)
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%                           # quita varianza cero si algún nivel no aparece
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())                # estandariza numéricas

prep_rec <- prep(rec)
X_scaled <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = NULL) %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("NObeyesdad"))

# Chequeos rápidos
stopifnot(!anyNA(X_scaled))
stopifnot(is.numeric(as.matrix(X_scaled)))
```

### DBSCAN con distancia de Gower (usando todas nuestras variables)

```{r  Db_Scan_todas}
library(dbscan)
library(cluster)

epsFinal = malla_param$eps[[1]]
minPtsFinal = malla_param$minPts[[1]]
siluetaInicial = -1

gower_dist <- daisy(df, metric = "gower") #Calculando nuestra metrica 
D <- as.dist(gower_dist)


for(i in 1:nrow(malla_param)){
  db <- dbscan(D, eps = malla_param$eps[[i]], minPts = malla_param$minPts[[i]])
  sil <- silhouette(db$cluster, as.dist(gower_dist))
  if (mean(sil[, "sil_width"]) > siluetaInicial) {
    siluetaInicial = mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
    epsFinal = malla_param$eps[[i]]
    minPtsFinal = malla_param$minPts[[i]]
  }
}
print(paste0("Eps seleccionado: ", epsFinal))
print(paste0("MinPts seleccionado: ", minPtsFinal))

db <- dbscan(D, eps = epsFinal, minPts = minPtsFinal)
sil <- silhouette(db$cluster, as.dist(gower_dist))

print(mean(sil[, "sil_width"]))

# EPS = 0.2
# MinPts = 1
# Silueta = 0.3390998
```

### Realizando clustering con PAM con distancia de Gower

```{r }
df_cat  <- df %>%
  select(where(is.factor))

#VIENDOI EL TIPO DE Df_cat
str(df_cat)

```


```{r }
pam_gower_pipeline <- function(df, k_range = 1:12, na_label = "(NA)") {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(df))

  D <- daisy(df_cat, metric = "gower")  # disimilaridad en [0,1]

  
  res <- lapply(k_range, function(k) {#  Probando  k por silhouette con PAM (diss=TRUE porque pasamos distancia)
    fit <- pam(D, k = k, diss = TRUE)
    sil <- silhouette(fit$clustering, D)
    sil_avg <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
    list(k = k, fit = fit, sil_avg = sil_avg)
  })
  best_idx <- which.max(sapply(res, `[[`, "sil_avg"))
  best <- res[[best_idx]]

  cat("Mejor k:", best$k, " | Silhouette promedio:", round(best$sil_avg, 4), "\n")


  clusters <- factor(best$fit$clustering)

  # Graficando en 2D con cmdscale
  mds <- cmdscale(as.dist(D), k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    Dim1 = mds$points[, 1],
    Dim2 = mds$points[, 2],
    cluster = clusters
  )

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(Dim1, Dim2, color = cluster)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9, size = 2) +
    labs(title = paste0("PAM + Gower (k = ", best$k, ")"),
         subtitle = paste("Silhouette promedio:", round(best$sil_avg, 3)),
         x = "Dim 1", y = "Dim 2", color = "Cluster") +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p)

   #Imprimiendo resultados de nuestro clustes
  list(
    clusters = clusters,
    medoids = best$fit$medoids,   # Mejor ajuste PAM
    silhouette_mean = best$sil_avg,
    k = best$k,
    plot_data = plot_df
  )
}

out_pam <- pam_gower_pipeline(df_cat, k_range = 2:12)
head(out_pam$clusters)
```

### Realizando HClust con distancia de Gower

```{r }
# ---------- Paquetes ----------
# install.packages(c("cluster","dplyr","ggplot2","forcats"))

hclust_gower_pipeline <- function(df, k_range = 2:12, method = "average", na_label="(NA)") {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(df))

  df_cat <- df %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ fct_explicit_na(as.factor(.), na_label)))
  D <- daisy(df_cat, metric = "gower")

  hc <- hclust(as.dist(D), method = method)

  # Evaluar k por silhouette
  evals <- lapply(k_range, function(k) {
    cl <- cutree(hc, k = k)
    sil <- silhouette(cl, D)
    list(k = k, cl = cl, sil_avg = mean(sil[, "sil_width"]))
  })
  best_idx <- which.max(sapply(evals, `[[`, "sil_avg"))
  best <- evals[[best_idx]]

  cat("Mejor k:", best$k, "| Silhouette promedio:", round(best$sil_avg, 4), "\n")

  # Proyección 2D
  mds <- cmdscale(as.dist(D), k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    Dim1 = mds$points[, 1],
    Dim2 = mds$points[, 2],
    cluster = factor(best$cl)
  )

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(Dim1, Dim2, color = cluster)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9, size = 2) +
    labs(title = paste0("HClust (", method, ") + Gower (k = ", best$k, ")"),
         subtitle = paste("Silhouette promedio:", round(best$sil_avg, 3)),
         x = "Dim 1", y = "Dim 2", color = "Cluster") +
    theme_minimal()
  print(p)

  list(
    clusters = factor(best$cl),
    silhouette_mean = best$sil_avg,
    k = best$k,
    hclust = hc,
    plot_data = plot_df
  )
}

# ---------- USO ----------
out_hc <- hclust_gower_pipeline(df_cat, k_range = 2:12, method = "average")
head(out_hc$clusters)

```



```{r Corriendo_k-modes}
library(klaR) 

ks <- seq(2, 12)  # k a probar
resumen <- data.frame(k=ks, sil_promedio = NA_real_)

#ajustes <- vector("list", length(ks))


for (i in 1:length(ks)) {
  k <- ks[i]
  fit <- kmodes(df_cat, modes = k, iter.max = 50, weighted = FALSE)  # simple matching
  # silhouette: etiquetas + matriz de distancias
  sil <- silhouette(fit$cluster, gower_dist)
  resumen$sil_promedio[i] <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])

}

resumen
best_k <- resumen$k[which.max(resumen$sil_promedio)]


print(resumen)
print(best_k)

```

```{r }
#Corriendo nuestro modelo seleccionado, podemos cambiar el numero de clusters
mejor_fit <- kmodes(df_cat, modes = 2, iter.max = 50, weighted = FALSE)  # simple matching
sil_best <- silhouette(mejor_fit$cluster, gower_dist) # Clculando nuestra silhouette

sill_mejor <-  sil_best[, "sil_width"] #Calculando el promedio de nuestra silhouette


# Grafica para ver la silueta por observación
plot(sill_mejor,
     pch = 19,        
     col = "blue",
     xlab = "Índice",
     ylab = "Silhouette width",
     main = "Siluetas por observación en K-modes")
abline(h = mean(sill_mejor), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)  # promedio
```

```{r }
mds <- cmdscale(gower_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)

coords <- as.data.frame(mds$points)
colnames(coords) <- c("Dim1", "Dim2")
coords$cluster <- labels

# ====== Gráfica ======
ggplot(coords, aes(x = Dim1, y = Dim2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1.8) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Clusters K-modes (k = %d)", nlevels(labels)),
    subtitle = sprintf("Silhouette promedio: %.3f", sil_mean),
    x = "Dim 1", y = "Dim 2", color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
